transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um, well, what really made me finally ask for help is that I just barely want to eat anymore. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, just staring at food I used to like, and... I don't know, I just end up throwing most of it away. I just don't have an appetite at all lately.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Um... I'm not really sure. I don't know if I'd call it feeling down or sad, exactly. I haven't really noticed feeling like that, to be honest. I mostly just noticed the food thing, like I was saying.
Are you avoiding food because you’re worried about gaining weight or changing your body shape?
No, it's nothing like that. I'm not worried about my weight or how I look or anything. It's just... I just don't feel hungry. The thought of eating just doesn't appeal to me at all.
Have you lost weight unintentionally since your appetite decreased?

Yeah, a little bit, I think. My clothes feel a little looser. Like I was saying, that's really what made me finally come in—I just barely want to eat anymore. When I'm at the store just throwing most of my lunch away every day instead of eating it... I guess the weight just kind of comes off without me trying.
Do you avoid eating because you fear something unpleasant happening afterward, such as choking or vomiting?
No, it's nothing like that. I'm not scared of choking or throwing up or anything. It really is just... I just don't have any appetite. I look at food and I just don't want it.
Has your reduced eating interfered with your daily activities or social life?

Not really, no. I mean, I still go to work at the store and do what I need to do. I don't really go out much anyway, so it hasn't stopped me from seeing friends or anything like that. It's just the eating part that's... not happening.
How long has your reduced appetite been going on?

It's been going on for about two months now. I think it started right around the time I got this award for a window display at the store, and the district manager started giving me all this attention. That's really when my appetite just kind of went away.
Approximately how much weight have you lost since your appetite decreased?

I don't know the exact number of pounds, since I haven't really stepped on a scale. But it's definitely noticeable. Actually, that's kind of what made me ask for help... I just barely want to eat anymore. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, just staring at food I used to really like, and I end up just throwing most of it away.
About how much weight have you lost since your appetite decreased?

Like I was just saying, I really don't know the exact number. I don't have a scale at home to check. I just know my work pants are fitting a lot looser than they used to, but... yeah, I couldn't give you an actual number.
Has a doctor identified any medical condition or started any medication around the time your appetite decreased that might explain it?
No, um... I haven't been diagnosed with anything else. And I'm not taking any medications or anything. So, yeah, there's no medical reason like that as far as I know.
Have you been told by a healthcare professional that you have a nutritional deficiency because of your reduced eating?
No, I haven't been told anything like that. I haven't really seen a doctor about any of this until now, so nobody's checked my nutrition or anything.
Have you needed nutritional drinks or supplements to get enough nutrition because you are eating so little?
No, I haven't been drinking any of those... like, meal replacement shakes or anything. I just eat whatever small amount I can manage during the day. So, no, no supplements.
Has your reduced eating made you avoid eating with other people or interfered with your relationships or social activities?

No, not really. I mean, I don't really go out much anyway right now, but it's not because of the food. It's just... I don't have the energy for it. If someone's around when I eat, it doesn't bother me or anything. I just don't eat a lot.
Can you estimate your weight before your appetite decreased and your current weight?

I don't really know my exact weight before or now, to be honest. I haven't weighed myself. But... honestly, the eating thing is kind of what made me ask for help. I barely want to eat anymore. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, just staring at food I used to like, and I end up throwing most of it away. So I know I've lost weight, I just don't know the numbers.
Has eating so little caused you to feel physically weak or lightheaded?
No, I haven't really felt weak or lightheaded. I just don't have an appetite, but physically, I haven't noticed feeling dizzy or anything like that from it.
Has your reduced eating made it harder for you to do your job or manage your usual daily responsibilities?

I'm still going to work, but... yeah, it's definitely affecting things. I've been messing up inventory counts and display plans at the store, enough that my manager has had to start double-checking my work. And outside of the job... I've just been skipping things. Like gallery nights, playing basketball, and these youth art workshops I used to always show up for. I just haven't been doing any of it lately.
